description: This file defines the IDeviceInfo interface and related data structures for device information, capabilities, and system details within the WPEFramework. It includes method declarations for accessing device properties such as serial number, model, firmware, network interfaces, and capabilities.

classes.name: IDeviceInfo
classes.description: Interface for retrieving device information and capabilities, including system info, hardware details, network addresses, and supported features.

classes.name: IDeviceAudioCapabilities
classes.description: Interface for querying audio capabilities of the device, including supported audio outputs, profiles, and MS12 features.

classes.name: IDeviceVideoCapabilities
classes.description: Interface for querying video capabilities, including supported resolutions, HDCP versions, and EDID information.

methods.name: SerialNumber
methods.description: Retrieves the device's serial number set by the manufacturer.

methods.name: Sku
methods.description: Retrieves the device model number or SKU.

methods.name: Model
methods.description: Retrieves the friendly device model name.

methods.name: DistributorId
methods.description: Retrieves the partner or distributor ID for the device.

methods.name: ReleaseVersion
methods.description: Retrieves the release version of the device firmware.

methods.name: SystemInfo
methods.description: Retrieves general system information such as version, uptime, RAM, and CPU load.

methods.name: SupportedAudioPorts
methods.description: Retrieves supported audio ports on the device.
